nodes.description: Map the repository: entry points, test command, layout.
Reproduce the reported failure with a minimal command.
Find the file and line responsible.
Decide the minimal change before touching files.
Apply the edit to the source file.
Run the narrowest test that exercises the fix.
Read the failure output before editing again.
Run the broader suite to check for regressions.
Report the change and the evidence it works.

edges.guidance: List the project layout and locate the test command before reading any source file.
edges.pitfalls: Do not open random files; find the test entry point first.

edges.guidance: Run the narrowest command that reproduces the reported failure and save the exact output.
edges.pitfalls: Do not start editing before you have seen the failure yourself.

edges.guidance: Use the traceback to grep for the failing symbol; read the smallest enclosing function.
edges.pitfalls: Do not guess the location from the issue text alone.

edges.guidance: State the minimal change and what test will prove it.

edges.pitfalls: Do not batch several unrelated edits; you will not know which one worked.
Never make a second edit before running the test.

edges.guidance: Read the new failure output in full before changing anything.
edges.pitfalls: Do not retry the same edit with cosmetic variations.
Do not loop between edit and test without reading output.

edges.guidance: Run the broader suite to catch regressions.
edges.pitfalls: Do not declare success on one passing test.

edges.guidance: Summarise the change and paste the passing test output.
edges.pitfalls: Do not claim success without test evidence.

guard.reason: This would discard the work done so far.
